groups.sentence: Instructors may state in the syllabus or in advance whether AI is allowed on exams and quizzes.
Students do not use AI tools during exams, quizzes or tests unless the instructor explicitly permits it.
Students do not use unauthorized notes, devices or outside resources during an exam; doing so is cheating.
Students do not use AI to complete assessments or assignments meant to show their own understanding.
Students do not use AI wearables such as smart glasses during assessments, and bring standard glasses if needed.
Students complete in-class quizzes solely as their own work.
Students check with their instructor before using AI on take-home quizzes, exams or assignments.
Instructors use in-person written exams with restricted internet and AI access.
Using AI to answer quiz or exam questions is a potential misuse.
